ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central proximal region exhibits a dense black isosceles-triangular pigmentation zone with white stippling. Lateral lobes are predominantly white with a continuous black border (approx. 5-10 pixels wide) along the trailing edge. A distinct vertical black streak is located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped median notch with a rounded base; calculated internal angle of approximately 112 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration frequency. The left lobe (viewer's left) features low-amplitude rounded peaks. The right lobe features high-amplitude, jagged peaks with a deep indentation/missing segment located approximately 70% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a symmetric concave curve tapering to acute distal tips; leading edge shows a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-intensity white circular calcified nodes (barnacle colonies) visible on the distal tip of the left lobe. Discrete white circular scars scattered within the central dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel vertical dark lines (rake marks) on the mid-upper right lobe. Multiple faint, unaligned horizontal scratches visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep traumatic V-shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, likely representing tissue loss. Vertical linear rake marks consistent with odontocete interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique stippled transition zone (salt-and-pepper effect) between the solid black peduncle area and the white lobes.
